facts.text: Best Friend is performed by Sofi Tucker.
Artist: Sofi Tucker · Title: Best Friend · Album: Sofi Tukker - Treehouse · Year: 2017 · Genre: Dance-pop · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2010's/Sofi Tucker - Best Friend.mp4
"Best Friend" is a song by American duo Sofi Tukker featuring Australian duo Nervo, American duo The Knocks and Japanese singer Alisa Ueno.
It was released on September 12, 2017, as the third single from their debut album Treehouse.
It was also featured in a commercial for the iPhone X.
Sofi Tukker (stylized "SOFI TUKKER") are an American musical DJ duo based in New York City, consisting of Sophie Hawley-Weld and Tucker Halpern.
They are known for their songs "Drinkee", "Best Friend", and "Purple Hat".
"Best Friend" was featured in a commercial during Apple's unveiling of the iPhone X, while "Drinkee" was nominated for a Grammy at the 2017 Grammy Awards.
